title: Console at phone width: audit and fix the key flows at 375px (the mobile app now hosts the Console)
body:
## Context

`objectstack-ai/mobile` 2.0 no longer renders business UI natively: it hosts the Console in a WebView (objectstack-ai/mobile#144). Phone users therefore get the Console's responsive layout and nothing else. The last mobile-layout card, objectstack-ai/objectstack#1325, was closed with the experience unverified.

## Ask

Drive each flow below in a real browser at 375×812 (and 390×844) against the showcase and CRM examples. Record what breaks and fix it. The triage seat may split this into one card per flow.

| Flow | Pages |
|---|---|
| Approvals | approvals inbox, approve / reject with reason |
| Lists | list view, filters, search, row actions, pull-to-refresh |
| Record | record page, related lists, inline edit |
| Forms | create / edit form, lookups, date and select fields, validation errors |
| Dashboards | dashboard with charts and KPIs |
| Notifications | inbox, mark read, open the target record |
| Navigation | app switcher, nav groups, back behaviour |
| Auth | sign-in, 2FA, password reset |

For each flow, check:

- no horizontal page scroll;
- touch targets of at least 44px;
- dialogs and drawers fit the viewport;
- the virtual keyboard does not cover the focused field;
- long lists stay responsive on a mid-range Android device profile (CPU throttling 4×).

## Acceptance

- A run record per flow, with the pass/fail of each check.
- Fixes for every failure, or a card for each one that is not fixed in this card.
- Playwright coverage at phone viewport for at least the approvals and record flows.
